patch_description: This combines the baseline’s direct-demand preference with a sparse, demand-weighted model of useful two-hop routes. Rather than rewarding every possible two-hop path equally, it selects only a few promising relays per origin–destination pair and discounts relays whose nodes already carry substantial traffic. A small endpoint-gravity term gives links some value as network connectors, while keeping direct demand dominant. The resulting chain couplings encourage plausible transit structure without letting the path bonuses overwhelm direct-link choices.
